items.name: Library sources and metadata
items.description: Allow local folders, choose Movies, TV shows, Music videos or Music, select an installed metadata provider and preview scanner changes. Existing remote and multipath sources are preserved as read-only.

items.name: Media folder access
items.description: Grant or remove read-only access for this profile. Kodi pauses safely while access changes and resumes afterward. Files are never moved or deleted.

items.name: Scan video library
items.description: Ask Kodi to scan configured video sources. Scanner status and errors appear here; this never cleans or removes library titles.

items.name: Scan music library
items.description: Ask Kodi to scan allowed music sources and embedded file tags. Browse Music, then an album, to play its tracks.

items.name: Browse, search and progress
items.description: Open Movies or TV Shows, then choose Music in the library toolbar to browse albums and tracks. Music page components offer the same library. TV Guide is available from Home or configured page components. Video controls provide search, genres, watched/continue/recent views and paging. Kodi owns watched state and resume positions.

items.name: Saved playlists
items.description: In Movies or TV Shows, open library controls, then Save playlist or Saved playlists. Preview rules, rename, change sorting, reorder file members or delete a playlist. Media and watched state are preserved.

items.name: Title posters
items.description: Open a movie or TV-show details card, then choose its poster. Select managed artwork, preview, cancel or confirm apply. Other title artwork is preserved.

items.name: Playback and next / previous
items.description: Confirm plays, pauses or resumes. Left / Right seeks when supported; Back stops and restores the origin. Menu opens Isolde playback controls. Previous / Next follows the current movie, episode or song list across pages; scheduled channels and legacy collections retain their own navigation.

items.name: Audio and subtitles
items.description: During video playback, Menu opens available audio and subtitle tracks, including Off. Capture-generated local subtitles can be loaded from Capture. Unsupported tracks remain unavailable rather than being simulated.

items.name: Picture size
items.description: During video playback, Menu offers Normal, Zoom, Stretch 4:3, Wide zoom, Stretch 16:9 and Original. These use Kodi's player; music keeps the common playback controls.

items.name: Local playback preference
items.description: Choose whether verified local matches from online discovery play immediately or first show viewing choices. Library shelves always use Kodi directly.

items.name: Desktop Kodi import and rollback
items.description: Preview an existing desktop Kodi setup, create a private backup, resolve conflicts and import into this profile. The original installation remains intact; rollback restores the saved destination.

items.name: Backend startup and recovery
items.description: Automatic startup keeps Kodi ready in the background. Restart recovers the backend without requiring Kodi menus. Playback and scanning must finish before configuration ownership changes.

items.name: Supported settings and isolation
items.description: Sources, scanning, playlists, posters, local playback choice and player controls are managed here per profile. System audio, network, accessibility and remote bindings live in Isolde Settings. Kodi skins, arbitrary add-on configuration and device-specific video calibration are outside managed mode; imported values are preserved.
